name: phone_call
description: 📞 Make phone calls, call someone, ring, dial a number. Use when user says 'call my mom', 'call boss', 'phone Andrew', 'dial +1555...', 'ring my friend'. Jarvis calls on your behalf via Vapi.ai, has a conversation, and saves transcript. Actions: 'call' (make a phone call), 'status' (check result - 'what happened on that call?'), 'contacts' (save/list phone numbers). Call runs in background; ask 'what happened on the call' for results. Transcripts are auto saved to Canvas

action.description: Action: 'call' to make a phone call, 'status' to check a call's result, 'list' to see recent calls, 'contacts' to manage contacts

recipient.description: Who to call - can be a name from contacts (e.g., 'Boss', 'Andrew') or a phone number with country code (e.g., '+15551234567')

task.description: What should Jarvis accomplish on the call? Be specific about the objective. E.g., 'Ask if he wants to see Gladiator II at the 9pm showing tonight and confirm'

context.description: Additional context to help Jarvis on the call. E.g., movie details, previous conversation summary, etc.

persona.description: Persona/style for the call. 'default' is Jarvis (male), 'professional' is formal James (butler-style), 'casual' is relaxed Jay, 'female' is friendly Samantha

wait.description: DEPRECATED - DO NOT USE. Wait behavior is controlled by server config. This parameter is ignored.

add_name.description: Name for adding a new contact (with 'contacts' action)

add_number.description: Phone number for adding a new contact (with 'contacts' action)
